messages:
ada: Heads-up — noticed a spike in spot evictions in us-west2 (A100 fleet) last night. Chat-gen routes had ~3x error-budget burn window. Opening ops thread to decide monitoring + runbook changes.

mike: Do we have dashboard links or the exact metric names? want to get quick context.

ada: Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/spot/evictions?orgId=1&var-region=us-west2. Key metrics: `spot_evictions_total`, `spot_allocated_gpus`, `spot_free_gpus_percent`.

sarah: Proposal: create a fused eviction_rate signal so alerts are normalized by allocated GPUs. Example PromQL:
```
sum(rate(spot_evictions_total[5m])) by (region, instance_type) / sum(spot_allocated_gpus) by (region, instance_type)
```
Use per-region + per-instance_type groupings.

leon: I suggest alerting on sustained eviction_rate > 0.02 for 10m per region+instance_type (severity=page). Past incidents at ~2% for 10-15m correlated w/ degraded tails.

ada: Confirmed — our perf analysis showed ~2% eviction sustained => 5-7% tail latency increase for small-seq models and occasional 429s on burst paths.

mike: How do we map this to SLO impact? can we compute per-region slo_burn metric?

ada: Quick-ish SLO proxy (by region):
```
sum(rate(request_errors_total{route=~"chat-.*"}[10m])) by (region) / sum(rate(requests_total{route=~"chat-.*"}[10m])) by (region)
```
Then correlate `eviction_rate` with `slo_burn` over the same window; alert if both are rising.

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-118 — reason: spot_eviction_rate > 0.02 in us-west2 A100. Notifying infra-oncall.

sarah: Runbook sketch for infra-oncall:
- Confirm eviction_rate panels + region instance_type
- If eviction_rate > 0.02 for 10m AND slo_burn > 0.01 for same region -> escalate
- Temporary mitigations: bump on-demand capacity in region (increase dedicated pool by +10% or open reserved buffer), disable spot autoscale, deprioritize background jobs, enable immediate failover to mixed-capacity pool with on-demand fallback
- Postmortem: collect allocations, preemption logs, time-of-day spot market signals

leon: Also add automated traffic shift rule: when eviction_score bin for instance_type crosses threshold, move low-priority routes to cheaper but stable pools. Need safe rollback and canary.

ada: Dashboard/alert specifics: add alert channels -> PagerDuty group `infra-spot` (severity page), Slack -> #eng-infra and #oncall-rotation. Include `slo-risk:true` in payload so downstream runbooks triage quickly.

mike: Another metric for attention: `spot_free_gpus_percent`. Proposed rule: if `spot_free_gpus_percent` < 15% sustained for 5m -> warning (no page) so capacity team can preemptively provision. PromQL example:
```
avg_over_time(spot_free_gpus_percent[5m]) by (region) < 15
```

sarah: Action items: I will add the eviction_rate alert (2% / 10m) + the free_gpus warning panel. ada will update runbook text w/ explicit mitigation steps. leon will add Slack hook + PagerDuty integration.

ad a: @sarah @leon @mike — tagging you as owners. Please bump PRs with `infra/spot-alerts` branch. ETA for alerts + runbook update: 2 hours.

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll open the PR now and link the rule + runbook.

ada: One more long-term idea — compute an `eviction_score` per host (based on eviction history, market churn, latency impact) and use that to form mixed-capacity pools automatically. Follow-up next week to design the automation.

mike: Good plan. For now, getting the normalized eviction_rate alert and slo correlation in place should reduce noisey incidents and give clearer pagings.

leon: I'll add a short note in the oncall rotation doc with triage checklist.

ada: Thanks all — will monitor this evening and report back.
